checked_routes.result: The first-party Rune pixivFANBOX profile is discoverable, but its accessible route exposes no textual roster or creator-owned character documentation for Choco, Miruru, Raika, Rita, and Yurina.

notes: This five-member creator-family campaign is not exhausted. Retain the first-party creator profile route and leave every HOME relation unresolved until creator-published roster or character attribution text is available; do not promote repost metadata to authority.
